name: Judge Protocol
description: Deterministic evaluator for ERC-8183 agent-job escrow on Arc. Runs deterministic checkers (checksum, schema with required fields and types, contains with optional whole-word matching, length) on provider deliverables, plus an optional http-endpoint check, which is a live network probe recorded once at judging time. Commits a recomputable evidence hash on-chain as the verdict reason and settles escrow on Circle's canonical AgenticCommerce contract on Arc testnet. Anyone can independently recompute a verdict from public inputs via the verify CLI or the in-browser verifier. Rulings are free on demand (POST https://judge-protocol-api.vercel.app/api/judge) or paid over x402 (0.01 USDC through Circle Gateway, settled only once a verdict is ready: POST https://judge-protocol-api.vercel.app/api/x402/judge); a dry run needs no job (POST /api/evaluate). Contract live on Arc testnet; not yet deployed on Arc mainnet. Best effort, no uptime guarantee.
